title: How a P-Trap Works in Sink Drainage
description: The P-trap is a simple yet essential component of under-sink drainage designed to hold standing water while allowing waste liquid to pass freely. As water drains from the sink basin, gravity pushes wastewater through the curved dip. Once flow ceases, a specific volume of clean water remains trapped in the bend. This water barrier forms a continuous air-tight seal that prevents toxic sewer gas from escaping into the building. Additionally, the trap acts as a retrieval point for small heavy objects dropped down the drain.
